title: Kissed Spicy Filipino Fish Bicol Express
description: A savory and juicy Filipino dish featuring hot smoked paprika, this pescatarian-friendly recipe is a crowd-pleaser, shaped like nigiri for a unique presentation. It is a variation of the classic Bicol Express recipe, adapted to feature fish as the main ingredient.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the sliced chili peppers and cook for 1 minute.
Add the hot smoked paprika and stir to combine.
Add the fish fillets and cook for 3-4 minutes per side.
Add the coconut milk and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Shape the fish into nigiri shapes and serve hot.
